market_observation.comparison_rule: Indicative USD deviation requires quote/NAV/oracle-read clocks <=4h old and within 120s; oracle updatedAt is validated separately against the verified 82800s heartbeat, with its original age disclosed. Route estimates are not atomic executions.

usd_reference.basis: oracle reference; not firm executable dollar proceeds

peg.market_price_basis: Size-specific indicative route quote; independent USD reference and original clocks disclosed
peg.nav_basis: Contract NAV for an accruing fxSP vault share; not an independent market price

backing.collateral_ratio_basis: fxSAVE is a vault claim on fxSP; it has no independent dollar collateral ratio. No fxUSD system ratio is substituted.

liquidity.two_pct_depth_basis: Matched quotes are indicative coarse brackets; reference conversion, gas and independent clocks are disclosed. No firm executable capacity is inferred.

evidence.instant_basis: Both output legs less integer-rounded fee exactly once; same-block gauge simulation verifies.

accounting.basis: Gauge.balanceOf(custody vault) minus totalAssets, exact raw integers.

assessment.status: Under review · dated authored scores retained after evidence review

basket_reconciliation.basis: Token amounts and fee reconcile; dollar basket valuation withheld without timestamped token marks.

matched_exits.mark_convention: Pinned-block Chainlink USDC/USD reference; fxUSD and fxSAVE size-specific smallest-rung sell quotes converted with that reference; all clocks separate

usdc.basis: oracle reference; not firm executable dollar proceeds
